note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; jurisdiction unspecified. Only explicit relationships are drawn; a plain relation has no arrowhead and causal is drawn only when supplied. Links: solid = supplied as direct support, dashed through an inference ring = supplied as a disputed inference. Nothing weighs evidence or draws a conclusion. Editable brief fields: claims, evidence, links, uncertainties, elements, relationships, focusElement, relationLabels, traversalOrder.
